description: This file defines an ErrorBoundary React component that catches and displays errors within a React application, providing options to reload, clear data, and export user tasks. It includes styled components and interacts with user context, utils, and external Material UI components.

classes.name: ErrorBoundary
classes.description: A React component that catches JavaScript errors anywhere in its child component tree, displays an error message, and provides options for user actions such as reloading or clearing data.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromError
methods.description: Static method to update state when an error is caught.

methods.name: componentDidCatch
methods.description: Handles side effects when an error is caught, including logging and retry logic for dynamic imports.

methods.name: handleOpenDialog
methods.description: Opens the confirmation dialog to clear data.

methods.name: handleCloseDialog
methods.description: Closes the clear data confirmation dialog.

methods.name: handleConfirmClearData
methods.description: Clears local and session storage and reloads the page.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders either the error UI with options and error details or the child components if no error.
